channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Desmond Bane | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Desmond Bane from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Nick Nurse, on playing the Magic in the play-in game:

“Physical team. Big wings and aggressive guards. Suggs and Bane are two competitive, physical guys back there... They've been one of many teams in the league that hasn't been very healthy this year, so it's gonna be a tough game.”

Nick Nurse on Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Apr 12, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: God Shammgod on Tyus Jones, Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Anthony Black
item.description:
“They’re at the right age where they still young, but they, they young enough to dare. Dare to be great. And I, I believe like Paolo and Franz is going to be great, but Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Anthony Black, we got Tyus Jones. Now we got, we got so many great players. “And they all right. And I feel like right now they all are ready to make their mark. So I’m just happy and honored to be a part of it.”

God Shammgod on Tyus Jones, Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs, Anthony Black, Sep 2, 2025. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Desmond Bane
item.description:
“There aren’t too many people that I think the league regards as highly in their locker room, in their organization [and] in practice as Desmond Bane,”

Jeff Weltman on Desmond Bane, Jun 16, 2025. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Desmond Bane
item.description:
Weltman also thanks Cole Anthony and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for their time with the organization:

“We are very thrilled to welcome Desmond (Bane) to the Orlando Magic family,”

Jeff Weltman on Desmond Bane, Jun 15, 2025. Source: Twitter @therealBeede.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Desmond Bane
item.description:
“(Bane's) working really hard, so I envision in a couple games here, he's back in the lineup,”

Taylor Jenkins on Desmond Bane, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant, Desmond Bane
item.description:
Drew Hill:Darko Rajakovic on if it’s any easier to scout this game:

“It’s never easy to scout a team that has Ja Morant, Desmond Bane and Jaren Jackson Jr.”

Darko Rajakovic on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant, Desmond Bane, Jan 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Ja Morant on Desmond Bane
item.description:
Drew Hill:Ja Morant on Desmond Bane:

“Not worried. Listen, I’m on the team. So I got information that y’all don’t. I’m not worried. Sorry. I see him every day.”

Ja Morant on Desmond Bane, Dec 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.
